title: onprem-kvcache-schema-drift-fallback-hotfix
creator: Amina Patel
description: Summary: Several customers on Private/VPC experienced a high-severity outage during the 2026.03 operator Helm upgrade. The operator attempted a KV cache schema migration that left nodeagents in CrashLoopBackOff and caused inference requests to stall. This ticket coordinates the emergency mitigation, hotfix PR, and rollout plan.
repro_steps:
1) Deploy operator helm chart 2026.03 to a cluster with existing onprem runtime 1.18.
2) Operator reconciler triggers a KVCache CRD schema migration job.
3) Migration job writes a new prefix version into the cluster state while some nodeagents are mid-evictions.
4) Nodeagents fail to reconcile new KVCache format and enter restart loops; requests to the runtime report 503s and kv cache misses increase sharply; customers report timeouts and high latency.
impact: Multiple customers (3 enterprise, 5 mid-market) reported degraded inference throughput and intermittent timeouts. SLA violations risk; support escalations opened (INC-3421, INC-3423). Immediate customer-facing mitigation required.
mitigation_actions:
- Temporarily block the operator migration by adding helm values: operator.kvcache.migration.enabled=false and rolling restart excluded.
- Provide a safe rollback chart that sets operator.image to previous patch (2026.02.4) and uses helm --force to revert CR changes.
- Disable autoscaling on dedicated pools to avoid noisy neighbors during remediation.
- Opened a support playbook slack channel #inc-kvcache-upgrade and posted runbook.
proposed_fix:
1) Patch operator reconciler to perform migration in two-phase: create a dual-format compatibility layer and only flip active format after all nodeagents report schema-compatible.
2) Add leader-election guard to ensure single migration controller instance.
3) Validate idempotency and add a safe rollback key written to leader K8s ConfigMap.
4) Back-port minimal patch for 2026.03.1 that skips migration when previous schemaVersion mismatch detected and surfaces clear error logs.
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for migration idempotency and leader guard.
- Integration test in staging clusters with mixed nodeagent versions (1.17/1.18).
- Chaos scenario: simulate pod restarts during migration and ensure no nodeagent remains in restart loop.
- Canary rollout to two low-traffic customers, monitor key metrics (kv_cache_miss_rate, nodeagent_restarts, p95 latency) for 2 hours before wider rollout.
rollout_plan:
1) Immediately ship emergency chart tag 2026.03.1-hotfix to customers requesting it.
2) Apply helm value override to disable migration for high-risk customers.
3) Deploy patched operator to staging and perform canary on two customers.
4) Ramp to remaining customers in batches with 30-minute observation windows and automated rollback hooks if p95 latency increases >30% or nodeagent restarts >5/min.
rollback_plan:
- Rollback operator to image 2026.02.4 using helm rollback and restore previous ConfigMap state snapshot.
- If helm rollback does not converge, run operator-safe-sanitizer job included in the hotfix bundle to reconcile CRs back to the older format.
- Notify customers and apply temporary routing to hosted fallback where possible.
outgoing_communications:
- Sent PSAT emails to affected customers with mitigation steps and ETA.
- Support playbook updated: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/KVCache+Upgrade+Runbook.
- Slack thread: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C0UPV/INC-3421-upgrade-incident.
